title: Dem scrambles to change tune on trans athletes as Trump targets past record: ‘Annie Trannie’
summary: South Carolina U.S. Senate candidate Annie Andrews claims she was misrepresented on transgender sports after Trump dubbed her "Annie Trannie."

title: Trump says Rogers 'completely obliterated' El-Sayed in debate
summary: President Donald Trump claimed that GOP U.S. Senate candidate former Rep. Mike Rogers "completely obliterated" Abdul El-Sayed in a debate.

title: Trump sets up committee to investigate Fed Governor Lisa Cook over mortgage fraud allegations
summary: President Donald Trump's new White House committee will hear mortgage fraud allegations against Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook in a closed hearing.

title: Radical anti-Trump language riddles California voter guide on high-stakes ballot measure
summary: California's Prop 39 voter ID ballot guide draws backlash online for its politically charged language, including a reference to "MAGA billionaires."

title: Talarico disappearance has Dem volunteers worrying and Trump asking, 'What is going on?'
summary: Trump called James Talarico "MISSING IN ACTION" as the Texas Democrat's nearly two-week campaign trail absence sparks concerns about losing momentum.

title: Autism providers warn foster kids at risk from unintended consequences of Trump's Medicaid fraud crackdown
summary: Georgia foster families face losing autism therapy access as providers warn the government's Medicaid cuts go too far in the name of fraud prevention.

title: Federal grand jury hears evidence in probe of former Trump aide Cassidy Hutchinson's Jan 6 testimony: source
summary: A federal grand jury heard evidence about possible false statements Cassidy Hutchinson made to the Jan. 6 House select committee on the Capitol riot.

title: Trump calls Democrat he pardoned a 'loser' for not switching parties
summary: President Donald Trump slammed Democratic Rep. Henry Cuellar of Texas for not becoming a Republican after receiving a presidential pardon.

title: Women's college basketball player released from ICE custody, details conditions: 'Just me and myself'
summary: Kentucky State University's Aminata Seck says she spent a week in isolation in ICE custody after refusing to remove a knee brace for her torn ACL.

title: Massive 7.6 magnitude earthquake strikes Panama as officials investigate potential tsunami threat
summary: A powerful earthquake struck Panama's southern coast Friday, prompting officials to investigate a possible tsunami threat after the USGS lowered its magnitude estimate from 8.0 to 7.6.
